symbols.name: prime length
symbols.meaning: The prime length of the sequence z, a count of its complex entries.
symbols.quote: Let $q$ be a prime, the length of a sequence $z=(z_0,\dots,z_{q-1})$ of complex numbers.

symbols.name: input sequence
symbols.meaning: The sequence of q complex numbers that the transform acts on.
symbols.quote: Let $q$ be a prime, the length of a sequence $z=(z_0,\dots,z_{q-1})$ of complex numbers.

symbols.name: normalized transform
symbols.meaning: The normalized discrete Fourier transform of length q, with the scaling 1/q.
symbols.quote: Gaussian resampling rewrites the normalized [discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) $F_q$ of length $q$ as a transform over power-of-two axes.

symbols.name: source length
symbols.meaning: The length of the source transform, a count of its entries.
symbols.quote: Let $n_0<n_1$ be integers, the lengths of the source and target transforms, with $\gcd(n_0,n_1)=1$ and $n_1$ a power of two.

symbols.name: target length
symbols.meaning: The length of the target transform, a power of two that counts its entries.
symbols.quote: Let $n_0<n_1$ be integers, the lengths of the source and target transforms, with $\gcd(n_0,n_1)=1$ and $n_1$ a power of two.

symbols.name: source permutation
symbols.meaning: The source coordinate permutation, which reorders the outputs of the source transform.
symbols.quote: Let $F_{n_0}$ and $F_{n_1}$ be their normalized transforms, and let $P_s$ and $P_t$ be the source and target coordinate permutations, which reorder the outputs of $F_{n_0}$ and $F_{n_1}$.

symbols.name: target permutation
symbols.meaning: The target coordinate permutation, which reorders the outputs of the target transform.
symbols.quote: Let $F_{n_0}$ and $F_{n_1}$ be their normalized transforms, and let $P_s$ and $P_t$ be the source and target coordinate permutations, which reorder the outputs of $F_{n_0}$ and $F_{n_1}$.

symbols.name: identity constant
symbols.meaning: The power-of-two constant on the right side of the identity.
symbols.quote: Let $K=2^{2\alpha^2}$ be a power of two, where $\alpha\ge 2$ is an integer parameter of the construction.

symbols.name: construction parameter
symbols.meaning: An integer parameter of the construction, at least 2, that fixes K.
symbols.quote: Let $K=2^{2\alpha^2}$ be a power of two, where $\alpha\ge 2$ is an integer parameter of the construction.

symbols.name: first contraction
symbols.meaning: A linear contraction from the n_0-coordinate space to the n_1-coordinate space.
symbols.quote: Here $M_1:\mathbb C^{n_0}\to\mathbb C^{n_1}$ and $M_2:\mathbb C^{n_1}\to\mathbb C^{n_0}$ are linear contractions, maps that do not increase the size of a vector.

symbols.name: second contraction
symbols.meaning: A linear contraction from the n_1-coordinate space back to the n_0-coordinate space.
symbols.quote: Here $M_1:\mathbb C^{n_0}\to\mathbb C^{n_1}$ and $M_2:\mathbb C^{n_1}\to\mathbb C^{n_0}$ are linear contractions, maps that do not increase the size of a vector.

relations.quote: Gaussian resampling rewrites the normalized [discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) $F_q$ of length $q$ as a transform over power-of-two axes.
Gaussian resampling operates on the axes produced by the [Chinese-remainder address map](chinese-remainder-address-map.md).
Gaussian resampling is carried over by [Tensor product](tensor-product.md) to several axes: tensor products give the same identity for multidimensional transforms.
